item: Government AI bill / statutory AI testing duty
primary_value_seen: King's Speech 13 May 2026 names 27 bills; none is an AI bill and the speech text does not mention AI; only related item is the Regulating for Growth Bill (reducing regulatory burden through innovation).
conflict_or_note: No government AI bill or statutory pre-deployment testing duty found. Background briefing notes (129-page PDF) not read in full; search excerpts mention AI sandboxes under Regulating for Growth.

our_value: UK-025/026: research body, not a regulator; pre-deployment testing of leading models
primary_value_seen: About page: research organisation within DSIT; tests leading systems before public release and after launch; pre-deployment access to leading models. AISI blog 12 Oct 2026: AISI has 'independently evaluated more than 55 models before release'; 'AISI is not seeking to mandate requirements for frontier developers'.
locator_seen: About page; blog 'Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development' (12 Oct 2026)
conflict_or_note: Remit unchanged: voluntary access, no statutory powers. 12 Oct 2026 post lists 8 priority areas for future technical best practice incl. enabling independent evaluators.

primary_value_seen: AISI blog 5 May 2026 'Partnering with Microsoft to strengthen frontier AI safety': collaboration on evaluating high-risk capabilities and safeguard effectiveness; form (MOU/contract) and pre-deployment terms not stated. No published agreement text found.
conflict_or_note: No public text of any pre-deployment access agreement located; arrangements remain voluntary.

item: Starter Kit for Testing Agentic Systems for Safety and Reliability
primary_value_seen: Listed as a resource on the AIVF Resources page ('Starter Kit for Testing Agentic Systems for Safety and Reliability', with feedback form) and as 'Agentic Testing Guidelines' on AIVF home page, linking to an IMDA AI page anchor. IMDA press release 'Singapore Introduces New Initiatives to Strengthen AI Safety and Resilience' dated 14 Oct 2026 exists but body text was empty on two fetches; PDF not located (guessed URL 404).
conflict_or_note: New document (Oct 2026). Content (four-step approach, trajectory review, tool-use/handoff metrics) seen only in secondary press; primary text not read; must be downloaded by hand.

item: Starter Kit for Testing LLM-Based Applications current version
primary_value_seen: PDF cover 'Version 1.0 January 2026'; still linked as current by AIVF (also at .../large-language-model-starter-kit.pdf).

AIVF media factsheet 19 May 2026: AIVF to launch AI TAP for third-party testers, expected 3Q26; technical assessment validates testing services against guidelines such as the IMDA LLM Starter Kit; company assessment (good standing, financials, operations, business scope); no fees. AIVF Tester Accreditation page lists accredited technical testing firms: AIDX, Knovel, PwC, Resaro, Vulcan.
conflict_or_note: Voluntary market scheme; no statement that any agency or regulator must use accredited testers. Factsheet date 19 May 2026.

item: Whether testing guidance is binding on public agencies
primary_value_seen: No public instrument found making the Starter Kit, AI Verify or the MGFs binding on agencies. Starter Kit p.2 calls itself 'voluntary guidelines'. GovTech Responsible AI Playbook Litmus page (updated 29 Jul 2026) presents Litmus testing as advisory and does not cite IM8. IM8 (Instruction Manual for ICT&SS Management) not publicly found.
locator_seen: Starter Kit p.2; playbooks.aip.gov.sg Litmus page
conflict_or_note: Internal Government Instruction Manuals are not public; binding status for agencies cannot be confirmed.
